theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_lno_integral_norm_length
theorems.statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower K E L] [FiniteDimensional E L] [Algebra.IsSeparable E L] (v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K E) (b : AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v), b ≠ 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, Module.length v.toValuationSubring (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v ⧸ Ideal.span ({b} : Set (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v))) = (n : ℕ∞) ∧ v.ord (Algebra.norm E (algebraMap (AlgebraicCurve.Place.integralClosureAt L v) L b)) = (n : ℤ)
